independent_technical_reasoning: The title and test set establish post-boot/reboot intent, but the procedure only verifies and runs AGFHC; inventing a reboot loop would expand scope, while ignoring the title would lose coverage. Therefore the owner must choose the execution relationship explicitly. Each reboot is state-changing and needs a bounded terminal state, because automatic retry can turn a single boot failure into a loop. Full per-cycle logs are necessary since truncated tails/heads cannot prove enumeration completeness or absence of earlier errors.
